supporting_statement: Full access to paid features during your trial. No artificial usage limits. No obligation to buy.
supplementary_taglines: Test It on Real Work. Then Decide.
Take Your Time. Make an Informed Decision.

usage_rules.allowed_when: Trial provides meaningful access to the paid functionality being evaluated.
usage_rules.forbidden_when: Material advertised paid capability is withheld during trial without disclosure.

usage_rules.allowed_when: All advertised paid functionality is available and no material trial-specific restriction undermines the claim.
usage_rules.forbidden_when: Any material trial-only restriction on advertised paid features is undisclosed.

usage_rules.applies_to: Test It on Real Work. Then Decide.
usage_rules.allowed_when: Product can be evaluated through realistic workflows for its category.
usage_rules.forbidden_when: Trial blocks workflows customers reasonably expect from paid marketing.

usage_rules.applies_to: Take Your Time. Make an Informed Decision.
usage_rules.allowed_when: Copy does not imply longer trial duration or unrestricted extension than the product provides.
usage_rules.forbidden_when: Wording suggests open-ended trial or extension beyond documented trial duration.

usage_rules.allowed_when: Trial participation alone does not obligate purchase; payment method, auto-conversion, renewal, and cancellation are accurately disclosed before activation.
usage_rules.forbidden_when: Silent auto-billing, hidden subscription conversion, or undisclosed payment capture at trial start.
